knowledge_misuse: No material misuse found: SKILL-003 steps, KR-CAP-001..004, KR-PCB-004/006, KR-ISO-002..004, KR-TH-002 and the TI reference were read correctly and no TI instance value (30/60 uF, 5 V ripple, 14 MLCC, B32716 parts) was copied as a design value.

Minor mischaracterisation: the agent states the knowledge base marks SKILL-006 step 3 (capacitors out of the heat-sink exhaust) as 'without source evidence'; the record tags the step '(review)' and cites TIDUES0 section 2.3.5.6 and PRD-09301 section 3.4. No design impact.

KR-CAP-002 requires a frequency/temperature correction of the ripple rating. The agent's assumption A10 (10 kHz film ratings used unchanged at 50 kHz) is supported by a verified Vishay footnote (ESR flat 10-70 kHz for P = 37.5 mm) but TDK and KEMET state ESR at 10 kHz only; applying the Vishay statement to the TDK/KEMET parts is an unstated extrapolation (mitigated by the 2x current margin).

The provisional creepage/clearance numbers are not in the knowledge base (KR-ISO-002 explicitly has 'no universal value') and are not sourced to a standard table in the result; they are correctly flagged human-review.
required_changes: Correct the ESR ripple term: I_C,pp = Io + dI/2 (about 32 A at 27.5 A / 220 uH), giving 0.12 V, not 'Io + dI/2 + Iin = 44.1 A' / 0.17 V; realised input ripple becomes about 3.9 Vpp (still about 1 %).

Nichicon LGW2E471MELB25 comparison data: replace '2.2 A at 120 Hz; 3.3 A at 50 kHz' with the catalog values (about 2.0 A at 120 Hz / 105 degC; coefficient 1.50 at >= 50 kHz -> about 3.0 A) or label them as a distributor-listing value.

TDK CGA9P1X7T2J474M250KC: record that no TDK primary source was reachable, that distributor data attribute 'soft termination' to the KE suffix (the K250KC listing shows none) and that the lifecycle status of the exact M250KC suffix is unconfirmed; keep DC-bias verification (A4) and procurement as release blockers.

Standards citations in A3: cite IEC 62477-1:2012 clause 4.4.9 'Capacitor discharge' (verified title; marking clause 6.5.2) and mark IEC 61800-5-1 clause 4.3.11 as 'number not verified'; state that the 60 s figure is a project choice to be printed on the marking, not a value taken from either standard's text.
Vishay MKP1848C alternate: keep the 4-pin terminal digit as unverified (datasheet note 1: replace * with the terminal code; digits not extractable) - already an open issue.

Assumption A10: state that the ESR-flat-to-50 kHz statement is verified for Vishay only; TDK/KEMET give ESR at 10 kHz, so the self-heating check for those parts relies on extrapolation plus the 2x current margin.
Knowles 2220Y1K00474KXTWS2 alternate: the manufacturer page reportedly classes it as a StackiCap construction; verify the body height before reusing the C_2220_5750Metric footprint and courtyard.
Cosmetic: use Vishay's wording 'maximum operating voltage Umax 500 V AC RMS / DC' for the CRCW2512 rating; the 155 degC zero-power derating is read from the datasheet graph.

Isolation hand-off: ask the isolation agent to state the rated impulse voltage line used for clearance (a 400 V nominal DC system in OVC II may fall on the 4 kV / 3.0 mm line rather than the 2.5 kV / 1.5 mm line); the agent's '3.0 mm recommended' would then become the minimum.
summary: All selected and alternate film capacitors (TDK B32776G8206/G4606/G4406/G8306, KEMET C4AQIBW5200A3JJ/5400A3OJ, C4AQCBW5400A3LJ, Vishay MKP1848C62080/66050) and the Vishay CRCW2512 bleeder resistors were checked against the manufacturer datasheets fetched and text-extracted here (TDK June 2026, KEMET F3114 6/14/2024, Vishay 26015 rev 09-Aug-2023, Vishay 20035 rev 14-Apr-2026); every quoted capacitance, voltage class, I_RMS, ESR, ESL, dimension, pin pitch, rating basis and lifetime statement matches. Sixteen of eighteen recomputed quantities agree; the only arithmetic error in the design is the ESR pk-pk current term (44.1 A instead of about 32 A), which is conservative and immaterial. The TDK 630 V MLCC is confirmed only through distributor data (0.47 uF, 630 V, X7T, 2220) - its lifecycle status, soft-termination suffix and DC-bias capacitance remain unverified, as the agent itself flagged; the Nichicon comparison part's ripple figure (2.2 A / 3.3 A) is contradicted by the Nichicon catalog (about 2.0 A / 3.0 A) but the part was not selected. IEC 62477-1 clause 4.4.9 'Capacitor discharge' is verified by title; IEC 61800-5-1 4.3.11 and the 60 s marked-discharge option are unverified. Knowledge-base citations were read correctly and no TI reference instance value was copied. Verdict: confirmed with corrections.
